title: Prepare the next public Mahoraga UI upgrade
task: Use the temporarily public repository and current main to prepare the next conversation-first UI upgrade. Inspect and exercise the actual public interface where available. Test multi-turn conversation continuity, autonomous objective and dependency-graph updates, pending/success/failure tool states, admin-plugin and connector truthfulness, automatic integration and release visibility, rollback visibility, keyboard navigation, accessible announcements, and mobile/desktop layouts. Fix concrete defects only under web or cloud-app, add focused behavioral tests, and return concise rendered-browser evidence. Do not add credentials, private chats, personal context, browser history, plugin output, fake connector health, workflow changes, autonomy-policy changes, public local listeners, spending, or device activation.
